notes: Policy is not installation state or current runtime health. Null upstreams are not verified source identities. No version here is a request to upgrade.

tools.name: OpenCode
tools.rationale: V1 harness; V2 is outside this maintenance scope.

tools.name: OMO Slim
tools.rationale: Orchestration and delegated agents; preserve user-owned models and permissions.

tools.name: cc-safety-net
tools.rationale: Destructive-command guard, not a sandbox; native permissions still apply.

tools.name: RTK
tools.rationale: Command-output/token optimization; verify rewritten command semantics.

tools.name: opencode-mem
tools.rationale: Automatic project memory; source/config/tests remain authoritative; extraction may use a remote provider.

tools.name: Plannotator
tools.rationale: Optional local human review for consequential plans/diffs, not mandatory ceremony.

tools.name: AgentsView
tools.rationale: Local session/history/usage analytics outside runtime hooks; no required daemon.

tools.name: opencode-pty
tools.rationale: Explicit pilot only after runtime/platform/permission smoke; guards may not cover PTY commands.

tools.name: Simple Memory
tools.rationale: Replaced by opencode-mem; retain legacy data until replacement persistence is proven.

tools.name: TokenScope
tools.rationale: Replaced by AgentsView; remove only identified plugin-specific entries.

tools.name: DCP
tools.rationale: Not baseline: background compression loops were disruptive in the observed workflow.

tools.name: opencode-snip
tools.rationale: Not baseline: automatic shell rewriting can alter quoting/chaining or permissions.

tools.name: opencode-vibeguard
tools.rationale: Not baseline: masking and secret-boundary concerns require separate review.

tools.name: Morph Fast Apply
tools.rationale: Optional only after a demonstrated native editing limitation.

tools.name: opencode-ignore
tools.rationale: Optional only after a demonstrated native permission/safety limitation.
